newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end higher with Kinnevik, Volvo up.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end higher with Kinnevik, Volvo up.

text.p: 1600 GMT - Swedish shares ended higher on Tuesday on the back of a strong U.S. market.
* Stockholm general index up 1.74 percent to 2,706.76
* Investment and media group Kinnevik jumps 6.5
crowns to 203.5 after its partly owned cellular telephone operator Millicom International Cellular announced it would spin off and list its Asian operations.
* Automotive group Volvo rides on Retail and Wholesale Institute HUI's Monday forecast that new car sales will rise steadily to the year 2003, up six crowns to 197.
